purpose: Prevent M3 from retaining dead prerequisite edges when repetitive baseline Access/Arsenal quests are eventually retired. This is a future bridge plan only; the current 31-quest IDs remain authoritative until M1/M2 pass and a migration-safe consolidation slice is materialized.

edgeDisposition.reason: Borrowed Access is the intended authored successor to the generic Customs possession milestone. A successor must not require the quest it replaces for new profiles.
edgeDisposition.migrationRule: Existing profiles that completed Access Protocol: Customs keep history; completion is not replayed or converted into an automatic Borrowed Access success.

edgeDisposition.reason: Reserve PMC interception does not inherently require a representative key set. The old edge exists only while the frozen baseline is the accepted capability surface.
edgeDisposition.migrationRule: If a future distinct Reserve access operation is admitted, gate on that authored operation only when it represents a real capability needed by the intercept.

edgeDisposition.reason: The historical Precision Fieldwork counter is expected to collapse into the authored stand-off qualification. Observation Window should depend on the surviving precision capability, not a retired counter stage.
edgeDisposition.fallback: If stand-off-control is not admitted, Observation Window may become the single precision qualification and the external edge disappears.

edgeDisposition.reason: The Labs capstone must still require actual access capability, but the two historical Labs access quests are intended to merge into one authored clearance milestone.

optionalCapabilities.reason: Special weapons remain optional and must not block the core Admiral campaign.
